title: ProgramVendorViewDocument
description: Server-maintained transport vendor of one programme as dispatchers see it: exactly the vendor fields listTransportVendors returned (id, name, active). The vendor's phone number, bound programmes and every other field stay in transportVendors. Written by a trigger on transportVendors, one document per programme the vendor is bound to. Readable by accounts holding the transport dispatcher duty (coordinators included) and the programme owner.
